description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useRevealOnScroll' that leverages the IntersectionObserver API to trigger reveal animations on scroll events, with support for preferences for reduced motion. It also includes a helper hook 'usePrefersReducedMotion' to detect user's motion preference.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion()
methods.description: Detects if the user prefers reduced motion, useful for accessibility considerations.

methods.name: useRevealOnScroll(options = {})
methods.description: A hook that returns a ref and reveal state, using IntersectionObserver to trigger reveal-on-scroll animations, configurable via options and respecting user's reduced motion preferences.
